Selected simple survey tok-/tōk- responses match this family, retaining gemination and lect-specific final vowels. Gondi teke and other more divergent responses remain unassigned. proposals.evidence: DEDR131 explicitly gives Tamil/Malayalam aṇṇan, Kannada aṇṇa/aṇa, Kodagu aṇṇë, Tulu aṇṇe and Konda ana/anasi elder brother. These complete survey forms match that kinship family, retaining final vowels and the Konda relational ending. Nursery-word similarity and the cited Prakrit comparison limit claims about the precise transmission history; compounds and unrelated brother terms are excluded.
